run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the GTestXMLOutputUnitTest suite to verify Google Test XML output generation
test_testNonEmptyXmlOutput: test that a gtest binary produces the expected non-empty XML output with test results
test_testEmptyXmlOutput: test that a gtest binary with no tests produces an empty XML output document
test_testTimestampValue: test that the timestamp attribute in gtest XML output is a valid ISO datetime
test_testDefaultOutputFile: test that gtest produces the default test_detail.xml output file when no name is specified
